t: 安提波佩·康斯坦丁二世被德西德国王派来援助他的普里米塞里乌斯·克里斯托弗和伦巴德军队逮捕.
te: Antipope Constantine II is arrested by primicerius Christopher and Lombard troops sent to aid him by king Desiderius.
dz: 安提波佩·康斯坦丁二世被德西德国王派来援助他的普里米塞里乌斯·克里斯托弗和伦巴德军队逮捕.
de: Antipope Constantine II is arrested by primicerius Christopher and Lombard troops sent to aid him by king Desiderius.

t: 安提波佩·康斯坦丁二世被普里米塞里乌斯·克里斯托弗的伦巴德军队废黜并蒙蔽了双眼.
te: Antipope Constantine II is deposed and blinded by the Lombard troops of primicerius Christopher.
dz: 安提波佩·康斯坦丁二世被普里米塞里乌斯·克里斯托弗的伦巴德军队废黜并蒙蔽了双眼.
de: Antipope Constantine II is deposed and blinded by the Lombard troops of primicerius Christopher.

t: 教宗斯蒂芬三世被选入任上,并迅速寻求法兰克人的保护来抵御伦巴底人的威胁,因为拜占庭帝国已经无法…
te: Pope Stephen III is elected to office, and quickly seeks Frankish protection against the Lombard threat, since the Byza…
dz: 教宗斯蒂芬三世被选入任上,并迅速寻求法兰克人的保护来抵御伦巴底人的威胁,因为拜占庭帝国已经无法提供帮助了.
de: Pope Stephen III is elected to office, and quickly seeks Frankish protection against the Lombard threat, since the Byzantine Empire is no longer able to help.

t: 卡洛曼一世和查理曼被加冕为法兰克人的国王.
te: Carloman I and Charlemagne are crowned kings of the Franks.
dz: 卡洛曼一世和查理曼被加冕为法兰克人的国王.
de: Carloman I and Charlemagne are crowned kings of the Franks.
